title: Optimal Execution under Incomplete Information
abstract: arXiv:2411.04616v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study optimal liquidation strategies under partial information for a single asset within a finite time horizon. We propose a model tailored for high-frequency trading, capturing price formation driven solely by order flow through mutually stimulating marked Hawkes processes. The model assumes a limit order book framework, accounting for both permanent price impact and transient market impact. Importantly, we incorporate liquidity as a hidden Markov process, influencing the intensities of the point processes governing bid and ask prices. Within this setting, we formulate the optimal liquidation problem as an impulse control problem. We elucidate the dynamics of the hidden Markov chain's filter and determine the related normalized filtering equations. We then express the value function as the limit of a sequence of auxiliary continuous functions, defined recursively. This characterization enables the use of a dynamic programming pri

translated_title: 不完全信息下的最优执行
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2411.04616v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们研究了在有限时间范围内，针对单一资产在部分信息下的最优清算策略。我们提出了一个专为高频交易设计的模型，通过相互刺激的标记霍克斯过程捕捉仅由订单流驱动的价格形成过程。该模型假设了一个限价订单簿框架，同时考虑了永久价格影响和瞬时市场影响。重要的是，我们将流动性视为一个隐马尔可夫过程，它影响买卖价格的点过程强度。在此设置下，我们将最优清算问题表述为一个脉冲控制问题。我们阐明了隐马尔可夫链滤波器的动态，并确定了相关的归一化滤波方程。然后，我们将值函数表示为一列辅助连续函数的极限，这些函数递归定义。这一特性使得可以使用动态规划原理。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在部分信息下、基于隐马尔可夫流动性模型的最优清算策略，并通过脉冲控制与滤波方程将值函数递归表示，从而为高频交易中的订单流驱动价格形成提供了动态规划求解方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimal liquidation strategy under partial information using a hidden Markov liquidity model, formulated as an impulse control problem with filtering equations, enabling dynamic programming for high-frequency trading.
